banner.title: actions-runner-maintenance
banner.tagline: A 15-minute CronJob that removes orphaned home-ops runner registrations and cancels workflow runs stuck in the queue.

art.about: a cleanup job that prunes orphaned CI runners
art.title: Runner maintenance

explainer.title: Three passes over one repository, failing closed

steps.title: Sweep
steps.text: An offline runner with no Pod of the same name is deleted. A runner whose Pod still exists is left for ARC to finish registering.
steps.scene: a ghost silhouette fading beside a pod

steps.title: Cancel
steps.text: Queued workflow runs older than 30 minutes are cancelled, so one stuck job cannot hold the queue.
steps.scene: a queued stack of cards with one crossed out

steps.title: Report
steps.text: In-progress runs older than 60 minutes are logged as warnings only. A long build is not killed.
steps.scene: a clock over a running process bar

steps.title: Fail closed
steps.text: If the Pod list fails or the token is missing, the sweep deletes nothing for that run.
steps.scene: a closed gate across a set of runner pods
